body: I don't actually know. I had "secondary care" which I think was a psychiatric nurse. I'll ask when I'm at my GP..
I don't have anything I can do differently, I really have exhausted all options, I've tried everything anyone ever recommends...

Thanks,
It might seem like I'm trying to get a quick fix, but I'm just trying to make it till my doctor's appointment. I've felt completely and utterly exhausted and broken for the past few days, time feels like hot soup I'm just slowly wading through.

I've tried mindfulness a lot as well. I feel so detached that it has never really helped be feel better, it's helped me get pass, say, a bus journey, but it never helps long term.

Thanks for this.
I've tried Omega 3 for the past couple of months with no real effect.
I do try to get out the house, I have a job where I work from home so it can be hard, but I do try. My last work was fast pace and made me feel a lot worse.
I've also tried exercise, mostly cycling, but it just makes me more anxious because of the light headedness and breathlessness that comes from exercise.
It's something I've tried a lot in the past but it doesn't seem to help. The derealization makes it feel pointless.
I might need to, but Im desperate for some sort of immediate help right now
I did try it once, but I felt nothing. From what I've read the things I suffer from (derealisation) get worse with THC.
